attributes.name: heading-subtitle terminal punctuation
attributes.definition: Whether subtitles and short taglines under headings end with a terminal period.

values.definition: Subtitles and taglines end with a period.
Subtitles and taglines have no ending period.

attributes.name: typographic punctuation in headings
attributes.definition: Use of typographic punctuation marks such as en or em dashes to join phrases in titles and subtitles.

values.definition: En dashes join phrases in titles and subtitles.
Em dashes join phrases in titles and subtitles.
Only hyphens, commas, colons or no joining punctuation.
